notes:
New in 0.1.4.6 - smaller pixels:
- 20 pixels per metre instead of 16 (a water pixel is now 5 cm instead of 6.25 cm). The level is the same 32 m x 18 m, now 640 x 360 pixels.
- Pixels are now perfectly sharp on 1080p (3x), 1440p (4x) and 4K (6x) screens.
- The water calculation costs about twice as much (more, smaller pixels). Performance mode is also finer and about 1.6x slower than before.
- The coast now runs all the way to the left edge of the screen.
